logos.siteminder-logo-navy.svg: Wordmark traced from the white-background logo in the official SiteMinder x Stripe video thumbnail (https://i.ytimg.com/vi/8OBzeYHS1YM/maxresdefault.jpg), Stratos navy #00033B

palette_source: Sampled from official SiteMinder video thumbnails and the wordmark (lime 'BOOKED' pill, royal-blue gradients, pastel report covers)

media: scripts/media.json lists every image in public/brand/media and its source video
